_comment: Single source of truth for the import-time NEXT_PUBLIC_* defaults that common/src/env.ts validates. Consumed by: desktop/bootstrap.cjs (packaged entry, via require), src/main/env-shim.ts (bundled belt-and-suspenders), scripts/dev-launcher.mjs (dev, via createRequire). Local BYOK ships no web backend; these are inert placeholders satisfying the schema. Keep values inert — never put real keys here.
